fn_8000A668 owns the jumptable_8023BF28 data-ownership boundary: its two dense switches dispatch through jumptable_8023BF28 (60 entries, values 0..0x3B) and jumptable_8023C018 (54 entries, values 6..0x3B); promoting it requires assigning .data 0x8023BF28-0x8023C0F0 to the TU and shrinking the auto data object.

MWCC 2.4.2 roots a switch binary-search tree at the median case value and emits a bare branch with no compare for a case whose body is empty. A retail pivot that sits below the lowest visible case therefore identifies a hidden empty case; this is how fn_800238BC's case -1 was recovered.
